Out of sample (2022-2025, 2352 games), the raw model’s cover probabilities scored worse than a coin flip (log loss 0.720, slope 0.05). A calibrated EV from it is the price’s vig, not a measurement of an edge. Status in the artifact: PROMOTED / SHADOW.
checks.remediation: Present EV as research only; no BET or LEAN on an unvalidated probability.

Out of sample (2022-2025, 2352 games), the raw model’s cover probabilities scored worse than a coin flip (log loss 0.720, slope 0.05). A calibrated EV from it is the price’s vig, not a measurement of an edge. Status in the artifact: PROMOTED / SHADOW.
checks.remediation: Present EV as research only; no BET or LEAN on an unvalidated probability.

timing_vocabulary.BET_EARLY: The governed decision engine certified this exact quote and a measurable reason says the number may not last: the market is moving toward EdgeDesk, or the next half point crosses a key number.
timing_vocabulary.BET: The governed decision engine certified this exact quote. No measured reason to hurry, none to wait.
timing_vocabulary.WAIT: Not now: a named piece of information is unresolved (a quarterback decision, a market too thin to trust). Never a forecast that the line will move.
timing_vocabulary.PRICE_TARGET: EdgeDesk still disagrees with the market, but the current number does not clear the threshold. The target number would; it is within ordinary line movement. Never a promise that it appears.
timing_vocabulary.PASS: No price that clears the threshold at any available number, or no disagreement worth acting on. The reason is printed.
timing_vocabulary.PRICE_GONE: The football opinion is unchanged, but the number that made it value is gone: the first price cleared the threshold, the current one does not.
timing_vocabulary.RESEARCH: The price clears EdgeDesk’s research threshold, but it is not a certified bet — the reason is printed (today: the cover probability is not calibrated for this model, or betting is disabled).
timing_vocabulary.INVESTIGATE: A gap the integrity checks have not verified, a data fault, or a market quote that contradicts another current quote. Not priced as actionable.
timing_vocabulary.NO_DECISION: Something required is missing, stale or malformed — the model, the probability curve, a current quote, or a valid price. EdgeDesk does not guess.

research_vocabulary.VERIFIED_MAJOR_DISAGREEMENT: A 7+ point gap that passed every integrity check. Still not a bet by itself.
research_vocabulary.WORTH_RESEARCHING: A research-sized disagreement (2 to 7 points) on usable inputs.
research_vocabulary.MARKET_ALIGNED: EdgeDesk and the market are within 2 points.
research_vocabulary.INVESTIGATE: A 7+ point gap that has not passed the integrity checks.
research_vocabulary.MARKET_FAULT: A 7+ point gap the market is too thin or too stale to verify.
research_vocabulary.DATA_FAULT: An integrity check found a data problem; EdgeDesk’s number is unsafe until explained.
research_vocabulary.LIMITED_DATA: No projection, no current market, or inputs too thin to lean on.

validation.rule: Timing is validated only by CLV, entry quality and price movement on prospective reads — never because BET EARLY reads happened to win. Rates print at n ≥ 30.

key_numbers.finding: At integer market lines the anchored distribution predicts a 3.4% push rate (raw 3.3%) against 5.3% observed (95% 4.0–6.9%); |margin| = 3 is 10.5% of 2023-2025 FBS games (the walk-forward folds) but carries 9.7% of the anchored mass, 7 is 8.7% vs 8.1%. Cause: the champion’s market-conditioned PMF (football/cfb_p4/engine.js cfbRecentre) puts less mass on the market’s own number than games land on: at a close of 3 it pushes 6.1% of the time against 9.6% observed, at 7 5.3% against 11.1%. The calibration anchor reweights that curve in place (lib/edgedesk_ev.js recentred), so every margin keeps its own mass: 9.7% at 3 and 8.1% at 7 (raw 9.6%, 8.0%), and 0.0% on a tie.
key_numbers.consequence: Key-number mass is NOT VALIDATED: an alternate line that crosses 3 or 7 relative to the market line is never actionable, and the juice panel prints the empirical share beside the model mass. A main-line EV at an integer number moves by about 0.1 pt of EV per 2 pp of push error at −110, so main lines are not blocked. No manual key-number bonus is added.

decision_vocabulary.BET_EARLY: The policy clears this exact, fresh quote on calibrated and robust EV, and a measured reason says the number may not last.
decision_vocabulary.BET: The policy clears this exact, fresh quote on calibrated and robust EV. No measured reason to hurry.
decision_vocabulary.WAIT: Not at this price: a named target price or a named piece of information would change the read. Never a forecast that the line will move.
decision_vocabulary.PASS: The price does not clear the policy on calibrated and robust EV, and no reachable target exists.
decision_vocabulary.PRICE_GONE: A previous quote cleared the policy; the current one does not. The frozen read stays as it was.
decision_vocabulary.RESEARCH_ONLY: The EV is shown as research: the policy is in SHADOW, the calibration is experimental, the inputs are limited, or an extreme EV has not been verified.
decision_vocabulary.NO_DECISION: Something required is missing, stale, unsupported or faulty. EdgeDesk does not guess.
